chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Katib reported to me, saying: al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Za'farani reported to me, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, from Yusuf ibn Kulaib, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hisham, from al-Sabbah ibn Yahya al-Muzani, from al-Harith ibn Hasira, who said: A group from the companions of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) narrated to me that one day he said:

"Call for me the tribe of Ghunay and Bahilah and another tribe that he had named, and let them take their shares. By He Who splits the seed and created life, they have no share in Islam. And I am a witness, and by my station at the Pool and at the Praised Station, that they are enemies in this world and the Hereafter. I shall surely punish Ghunay with a punishment that will terrify Bahilah. And if my feet are firm, I shall drive tribes against tribes, and tribes against tribes, and I shall expose sixty tribes that have no share in Islam."

key_terms.أبهرجن: I shall expose/falsify -- meaning to unmask or declare fraudulent
key_terms.الحوض: The Pool -- a reference to the Pool of Kawthar, a station of intercession in the Hereafter
key_terms.المقام المحمود: The Praised Station -- an eschatological station of honor on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.عطاياهم: Their shares/gifts -- referring to the distribution of public treasury (bayt al-mal)
key_terms.فلق الحبة وبرأ النسمة: He Who splits the seed and created life -- a solemn oath formula commonly used by Imam Ali

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the tribes of Ghunay and Bahilah?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Amali of al-Mufid, Imam Ali (AS) publicly declares certain Arab tribes -- specifically Ghunay and Bahilah -- as having no genuine share in Islam, calling them enemies in both worlds. Delivered during his caliphate in Kufa, this statement reflects the political tensions Ali faced with tribal factions who outwardly professed Islam but harbored hostility toward his authority. The oath formula "by He Who splits the seed and created life" is a well-known expression of Ali emphasizing the gravity of his words.
